scenes.name: ONE SQUARE
lines: Fill a grid with zero, one and two. In every small square, require four different signed clockwise differences. How many grids work?
用零、一、二填网格，要求每个小方格的四条顺时针整数差互不相同。这样的网格有多少？
This square gives one, minus one, two, minus two. The differences sum to zero, so zero is the missing difference.
这个方格给出一、负一、二、负二。四条差的和为零，因此被遗漏的差是零。
Only eight local squares work. Their connections will turn our grid problem into a walk.
合格的小方格恰好有八种。它们的连接会把网格问题变成走路问题。

scenes.name: TWO STARS
lines: Read a two-row grid by columns. A card records its top and bottom entries. Allowed neighboring cards form two stars.
把两行网格按列读，每张卡片记录上下两个数。可相邻的卡片组成两颗星。
From a center, choose either leaf, then return. Every two steps double the choices. Starting at a leaf also gives two choices every two steps.
从中心选一个叶子，再回到中心，每两步选择数翻倍。从指定叶子出发也是如此。
Counting every starting card, the two stars have four times b of r walks of positive length r. The sequence b begins two, three, four, six, eight, twelve.
把所有起点都计入，两颗星的正步数 r 的走法共有四倍 b(r) 条。b 从二、三、四、六、八、十二开始。

scenes.name: WHOLE ROWS
lines: Now make each whole row a vertex. Join two rows when stacking them produces allowed squares. Each walk step adds a row.
现在把整行当成一个点，两行叠放合法就连边。每走一步就增加一行。
Only the alternating zero-two rows can branch. Any other usable row contains a one, which fixes a neighboring pair. Extending left and right is then forced.
只有零二交替的两行能分叉。其他可用行含有一，它会确定邻行的一对数字，向左右延伸也都被迫确定。
The usable part is two stars and separate edges. Count those edges by reading the same two-row grid as a column walk: there are two times b of k, minus four, separate edges.
因此图的非孤立部分由两颗星与独立边组成。同一两行网格又是列卡片图的走法，由此算出独立边共有二倍 b(k) 减四条。

scenes.name: ADD THE WALKS
lines: For n plus one rows and k plus one columns, n and k are at least one. The stars contribute four times b of n walks.
对于 n 加一行、k 加一列，n 与 k 均至少为一。两颗星贡献四倍 b(n) 条走法。
Each separate edge gives two walks of any positive length: start at either end and keep alternating. Isolated vertices contribute none.
每条独立边在任意正步数时都给出两条走法：从两端之一出发，来回交替。孤立点没有贡献。
Add, then divide the actual count by four, as in the original problem. The answer is b of n plus b of k minus two. This is a numerical normalization, not a quotient by symmetry.
相加后，按原题约定把实际计数除以四，答案就是 b(n) 加 b(k) 减二。这是数值归一化，不是把对称填法合并。

scenes.name: FIVE COLUMNS
lines: With five columns, k is four and b of four is six. The normalized counts begin six, seven, eight, ten, twelve, sixteen.
五列时 k 等于四，b(4) 等于六。归一化计数从六、七、八、十、十二、十六开始。

The odd and even formulas below hold for every nonnegative integer m. The five-column Lean theorem also proves the recurrence from index four and the formal generating function with constant coefficient zero.
下方奇偶公式对每个非负整数 m 成立。五列的 Lean 定理还证明了从索引四开始的递推，以及零常数项的形式生成函数。

Hardin posed the problem and Barker conjectured these formulas. Ma and Zhang explain every width through the graph decomposition; those broader results have the written proofs in the accompanying reading.
Hardin 提出问题，Barker 猜想这些公式。Ma 与 Zhang 用图分解解释任意宽度，更广的结论在配套阅读中给出书面证明。
